title: Hunting with a mechanical emu in a year 2196 desert
author: Different-Director82
selftext:
The year is 2196 and you are controlling the only mechanical emu left, who's living in a future desert, trying to survive. You are avoiding dangers and storms and hunting hares and other metal animals. To your help, you have a mechanical greyhound (not in this demo) which you co-hunt with. You can plan the hunt together with him, to chase the animals in your direction.

That's the idea I have been working on. My team is consisting of me (Game director, play tester & art creative), Fable 5.2 (Planning honcho, high-level executive), Opus 5.5 (Head of subagents and R&D boss). That together with Unreal Engine 5.8 and Blender was a really smooth combo.

  
What do you think about it?
